extra_quotes: To connect the breakdowns to hardware, we also benchmark the seven kernels of Layer 3 in isolation, using GPU libraries [52], [65] or reference implementations, and place each on a roofline built from measured rather than vendor-specified roofs.

A shared server (five NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB cards; dual Xeon Gold 6248R, 96 logical cores) ran the kernel micro-benchmarks, the zkLLM breakdowns and the CPU-only provers; an exclusively used server (one A100-PCIE-80GB card of the same architecture; 192-core host) ran VeriLoRA, DeepProve, the commitment comparison and the engineering waterfall.
W4 runs on a single-threaded CPU prover with small networks and indicates trends only.
Capacity (Q4) is observed at two points, 40 and 80 GB, not as a continuous comparison.
